answer: Prayers & Duties >> Oaths & Vows Question ID: 151371 Country: INDIA Title: If someone says in-shaAllah before doing something will it be considered an oath? Question: If someone says in-shaAllah before doing something will it be considered an oath? Answer ID: 151371 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1055/911/SN=8/1438) In-shaAllah is said for expressing one’s trust in Allah; it does not make the speech as oath. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
